item.title: GTA 6 has now exceeded 50 MILLION copies sold since launch and generated $4.7 BI…
item.description: GTA 6 has now exceeded 50 MILLION copies sold since launch and generated $4.7 BILLION, according to Alinea Analytics. That makes it the #13 best-selling game of all time in just a week, and the new Online mode hasn’t even been revealed yet. Insane. @RockstarGames 😠
